# omadafusion_controller (Data Source)

Controller identity from the unauthenticated `/api/info` endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omadafusion_controller" "this" {}

output "controller_version" {
  value = data.omadafusion_controller.this.controller_version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) Web API version.
- `category` (String) Controller category, e.g. `advanced`.
- `configured` (Boolean) Whether initial setup is complete.
- `controller_version` (String) Controller software version, e.g. `6.3.14.2`.
- `id` (String) Controller ID (`omadacId`).
- `type` (Number) Controller type code reported by the controller.
